balls.text: bowled him! GT are cleaned up for 89. Noor has a swing at this length ball just outside off, but there is not foot movement even as he is deep in the crease, with his front leg out of the way. So Noor is beaten, and the ball strikes the side of the off stump
drives at this full ball angled into off, and a misfield at short cover allows him a single

tickled to Pant! Rashid went upper-cutting at this short ball in the channel outside off, but played at it away from his body and while still in the crease. The ball took a faint top edge, as Pant took the catch with a reverse cup. GT's last hope is gone
on a full length, and around sixth stump. Keeps low, as he looks to defend but is beaten
slower, and full on leg. This hints to turn away, and is blocked down from deep in the crease
on a length on the stumps, and swiped to deep midwicket
full on leg, and hits his pad to roll to short fine as he looked to clip
six wide of long-off! The first six of the day. He goes reaching out with a horizontal bat at this fullish ball angling across and finishing wide of off, and sends that ramming

ahh, Pant is appealing for a potential caught-behind after he thought the ball came off Rashid's boot. But replays confirm the ball bounced just on the side of his front foot, as Rashid skipped down the pitch and went swiping across the line at this length ball
he makes room, and drills this full ball on the stumps to long-off to retain strike
pushes forward at this full ball on off, but gets it to long-on off the inside half of the bat
slows it down, and bowls full on middle and off. Defended down late by Noor
gets an outside edge behind point, as he pushed at this fullish ball on off
angled in, and full on the stumps. Nudged to midwicket
cuts hard at this length ball just outside off, and plays to deep point. He takes the single first ball, though

taken at deep backward point! Sumit was placed at deep point, but went to his left to take it low. Khaleel, from around the wicket to Mohit, went for the bouncer around sixth stump. Mohit rode the bounce by leaping in the crease, and went ramping at it. But the ball flew off the top edge, and went dipping on to Sumit
shapes to walk down, and swats at this short-of-a-length ball on leg after also making room. The ball is flayed to deep point
short of a length on leg, and shaping away. Punched to extra cover
goes slashing at this length ball on off, which angles across, but is beaten. The ball also keeps low there
leading edge to deep third, as he closed the face of the bat to try and clip this length ball angling into off
pretty full and angling across towards off. Driven to long-off
slower, and tossed up. It is quite full on off, and pushed off the inside half of the bat towards cover
quicker and shorter on middle, and nudged back to the bowler
length ball just outside off, and punched to point
now Mohit wants to clip, but is hit on his front pad outside leg, with the ball being full on leg
full ball angled in, and pitching outside leg. It heads down, as Mohit attempts to flick but misses. Wide called
this is slower, and shorter too. The line is wide outside off, and again flashed hard to deep point
on a length just outside off, and stays a bit low. Slashed to deep backward point
he leans forward to push at this full ball wide-ish of off to play to point
now Mohit looks to sweep at this full ball angling into leg, and gets it off the bottom of the bat to beat Pant to his left. Axar from slip chases the ball all the way back
ohh, this keeps low while turning in off a fullish length outside off. It ends on middle and off, as Mohit taps down off the inside edge. The ball rolls towards square leg
ahh, beaten! This is angled in on a length on off, but it turns away to beat Mohit's attempted defence
turns away off a fullish length outside off, and is pushed to point
short of a length on middle and off, with a hint of turn away. Punched to long-on
angled in on a length, as it pitches on middle and off, but hits his pad outside leg, as he looked to clip
on the fuller side of a length on off, and straightening away. Dabbed down on the pitch
skips down, and lofts this length ball angled into leg. It goes wide of long-off after a few bounces
this skids through off a length on middle and off. Pushed off the inside half of the bat, with the ball going to deep square

given out lbw after Axar's confident appeal. But Tewatia reviews. He went for the slog sweep at this length ball outside off, which turned in to hit him on middle on the side of his front knee. Replays show the ball turned in quite considerably, and it comes up as umpire's call on clipping the side of the leg stump. GT sliding further, with Rashid their only hope now
on a length on the stumps, and punched to point. Hope there throws at the bowler's end, but Axar is wide of the stumps
another ball which is quite full on off, and dragged to long-off
quite full, and slow too, as it is on middle and leg. Flicked to fine leg
loopy and full, and dipping on a full length just outside off. Driven to long-off
tossed up, and dipping on a full length on middle and leg. Nudged down towards square leg, and they pinch a single
ahh, now he is beaten looking to cut at this length ball just outside off, and this one doesn't turn either way
this turns away off a fullish length from outside off, and finishes wide of off. Swatted to cover
length ball angled in, and straightening away towards off. Pushed back to the bowler
off the top edge, and four to deep third! On a length just outside off, and almost skidding through. He went cutting hard, and the ball flew over the slip fieler
length ball just outside off, and slashed to deep point
full on the stumps, and defended back
fuller side of a length just outside off, and clipped towards square leg
fuller side of a length just outside off, and dabbed on the pitch
short of a length on middle and leg, and pulled to deep backward square leg, where Khaleel slides to keep it to two
slashed to deep backward point! On a length around sixth stump, and Rashid cuts hard after riding the bounce to beat deep point diving to his left

wow, looks like this could be lucky for Pant and DC! Pant certainly seems thrilled. Shahrukh tried to swipe at this length ball which pitched outside leg, but the ball slid below his bat. He had taken a step or two down the pitch too, and as fortunate as it could get for Pant, the ball dropped off his glove and hit the leg stump. But the third umpire wants to confirm if it is the ball hitting the stumps, or the gloves. The stumps are hit, but it lights up a second or two later. Finally, the third umpire concludes that the ball has hit the stumps cleanly, with Shahrukh's back foot outside the crease. The ball is called wide, but it doesn't matter to DC - they have a wicket!
quite full and just outside off. Pushed back to the bowler

Pant is delighted for a potential stumping... but this will go to the third umpire too. Manohar was trying to push at this length ball dipping just outside off, but was beaten on the outside edge. His back foot seems just outside the crease, and the third umpire concludes that no part of it is on the crease. So Pant stumps Manohar, as Stubbs strikes
skips down, and crashes this full toss dipping on off stump to play between the stumps and the bowler
tosses it up, and bowls full outside off. Pushed off the inside edge to square leg

ahh, Kuldeep slows it down! Tewatia is beaten in trying to push forward, almost losing his balance in trying to do so, as the ball turns away off a full length around off. The ball goes past the outside edge, and Pant half-appeals for a potential stumping. And replays show Tewatia's back foot is ground when Pant flicks the bails off
this turns away off a full length on off, as Tewatia pokes to point. He sends Manohar back
ahh, some extra bounce off a length on middle and off, and turns away to finish outside off. Pushed off the outside edge, with the ball going towards cover
fuller still, and dipping just outside off. Tucked towards cover for a hurried single
full length on middle and off, and flicked to deep square leg
on a fullish length on middle and leg, and turning away a bit. Clipped towards deep midwicket
shorter side of a length on the stumps, and clipped to deep midwicket to beat the man close in at midwicket
punches at this length ball angled in towards off, as the ball goes towards mid-off
on a short of a length just outside off, and angling in towards off. Dabbed down from deep in the crease
very full, and dipping on middle and off. Flicked to deep midwicket, after first shaping to almost swipe at it
on a good length, and wide of off. Tewatia goes slashing, but is beaten this time
driven aerially to deep extra cover! He reaches out for this very full ball on sixth stump, and places it wide of the man at cover and also beats deep point
taps at this length ball angling into off. The ball goes to cover, and this time Mukesh bowls a no-ball

bowls a bouncer, which takes off from off stump. Tewatia shapes to pull, but the ball goes way over his bat. It is not given wide, and Tewatia reviews. It is overturned to be called wide, with the bounce being a bit too much on that occasion
ohh, beaten outside off! On the fuller side of a length, and wide of off, as Manohar went driving but the ball went past the outside edge
yorker just outside off, as the ball angles in. Manohar jams his bat down, and the ball rolls towards point
punches at this length ball around sixth stump, but the ball takes the inside edge and drops down on the pitch
on the bounce to Pant! He dives to his left, but the ball just falls short. Manohar went flicking at this fullish ball shaping back into leg, as Manohar got an inside edge there
much fuller length, and just outside off. Defended back with his head down
angles this in on a short of a length around sixth stump, and is punched to point

loud and confident appeal for caught behind, but not given. Pant reviews after being nudged by Ishant and Fraser-McGurk at slip. Miller went pushing with a half-closed face of the bat, which was placed outside off. And he starts walking back after seeing the first replay. There was gap between bat and pad there, and the UltraEdge confirms Miller got an inside edge. And Pant did well to take that, diving to his left even as the ball was dying on to him. His gloves were on the ground when he took the ball. Ishant bowled on a short of a length again, and this one angled back in from outside off to finish on middle
on the shorter side of a length just outside off, and shaping back in towards middle and off. Bunted down towards cover
fuller side of a length around off, and Miller defends from off stump
short of a length, and angling into his pads. Clipped to fine leg to pick two
nudges this short-of-a-length ball just outside off towards midwicket

direct hit at the non-striker's end! The umpire has gone to his TV colleague after Capitals appeal. And Sudharsan is clearly short, even as he dives back. The bat is well short, though. Length ball from Ishant just outside off, and Sudharsan clipped it towards midwicket. Sumit rushed towards the ball, and throw at the base of the stumps
short and around sixth stump, as Miller cuts forcefully on the bounce to point

chopped on! Saha went swinging across the line again, and this time fell. Mukesh bowled on a short of a length just outside off, and this time there is extra bounce for him. Saha tried to attack by but got a bottom edge, as the off stump was uprooted
very full length, and on a wide line. Flat-batted back towards mid-on
short of a length in the channel, and nudged towards midwicket. And there is a late call that it is a no-ball
chipped to the right of mid-on! Mukesh angles this in and goes on a length around off, and Sudharsan seemed to have pushed at it early

another attempted swipe from Saha, but he is beaten again. The ball lands on a length around off, and shapes back in towards leg as he goes across the line. The ball takes his pad, and trickles to the off side
on a length, and angling in to finish just outside off. Pushed to mid-off
wow, this is superb! He goes low and on his back knee to drill it between cover and point. Fullish ball just outside off, and he presented the full face of the bat to drive at that
short of a length in the channel, and punched with the full face of the bat. There is a misfiled, as cover throws his hands to his left, and the ball races away to deep extra cover
tucks this fullish ball going on straight after pitching on off. The ball rolls to cover
goes swiping at this length ball on his pads, but the ball hits the side of his pad and dribbles towards short fine. Another mistimed hit from a batter today
on a length just outside off, as he goes back to tap it towards point to get off the mark
now a leading edge from Saha. He went flicking off this full ball on leg, but the ball ended up towards point, as they went for the single
appeal for lbw by Ishant, but turned down. On a length just outside off, as Sudharsan seemed to get across to clip but missed. The impact seemed to be outside off though
goes full and wide outside off, with Sudharsan letting it go. Wide called

chipped to cover! Shaw there takes it just below his face. Ishant went with a full delivery just outside off, and the ball seemed to go on to Gill pretty slowly. He went slicing almost a bit late, with the bat face opening belatedly, and the ball chipping to Shaw
uff, hacked aerially to deep point! That went right in the gap between point and cover. Gill went slashing with a flat bat again, playing late at this length ball which is wide of off
skips down, but is beaten! Ishant goes on a length, and in the channel outside off, as Gill attempts to slash with a flat bat, but the ball went through to the keeper
another gentle drive by Gill, as he reaches out for this length ball which is wide of off, but finds mid-off. The slowness of the pitch came into play on this ball, though
starts with a fullish ball angling in, and going in on middle and off. Flicked to deep square, with his bottom hand nearly off
ahh, a late decision to tap, and the ball goes to the keeper on the bounce. On a length and angling away towards off, as Gill plays after seemingly first hinting to let it go
effortless clip! Finds the gap between mid-on and midwicket, and doesn't even seem to put in too much there in playing this length ball angling across towards middle and off
angles this in, and goes on a shorter side on middle and off. The ball shapes back in to hit his pad, as the ball runs towards square leg and they pinch a leg bye
shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and ends around off. Dabbed wide of point, with the fielder tumbling to his left. Gill sends Saha back
fuller length, and angled across. Comes on to middle and off again, and is driven to mid-on
ahh, much better ball! Beats Saha outside off, as the batter goes pushing at this length ball on middle and off, which shapes away after pitching, and is beaten on the outside off
on a full length, pitching on seventh stump and slanting across to finish in front of first slip. The ball dies on its way, as Pant dives to his right to take that. Wide to start with
Delhi Capitals thrash GT with 11.1 overs to spare! Length ball around leg. Sumit tries to pull but it takes a bottom edge and rolls away to fine leg for four
good length ball, quicker one around off. Skidding through. Misses the cut
play and miss. Full ball on leg and it turns across the batter, going past his off stump. Misses the slog
gets a boundary away! Full ball on off and turning away. Enough space for Sumit to free his arms and he cuts in front of square, slapping it through the covers
full ball on leg stump. Quicker, skiddy ball. Blocked
full ball outside off stump. Poked to point
full ball on middle stump. Swings across the line, loses his shape. Ball goes away to short fine leg
chance of catch but lands between Johnson and Mohit at fine leg. Pant tried to slog sweep a six and end the game but ended up top-edging it
pocket dynamite! Dances down this track, and converts this full ball on off stump into a slot ball. Muscles a loft with the turn, sending the googly over the long-off fielder
good length ball on off. Slows things down. Turning into Sumit. He makes a bit of room and cuts to point
full ball on leg. Pant stays in his crease and pulls to deep square leg. Mistimed
length ball wider outside off. Googly is cut against the turn, sent to deep point
good length ball outside leg and turning into the right-hand batter. Sumit misses the flick, and it hits the top of his pad before going to the leg side
full ball wider outside off stump. Turning away, and he sweeps against the turn. To deep square leg
full ball outside off. Pant comes down the track but then sees the line, and ends up padding it away
inside out over cover! Tossed up, wider outside off. Pant stretches out, losing his shape almost, but still manages to slap it over the off side
full ball on off. Turning in. Pant tries the sweep. Misses. To short fine leg.
a rare legbreak from Rashid. Full just outside off and turning away. Past the outside edge with the batter tryng to fend. Powerplay done
full ball outside off. Tapped towards point but cut off by the fielder
and Rashid strikes! Hope tries an expansive reverse sweep, but he doesn't get the elevation, and ends up hitting it to Mohit at conventional short third.
no run this time
good length ball on middle. Clipped to deep square leg for a single
finally Rashid Khan. Full ball just outside off. Googly turned to the leg side for a single
stumps rattled! Full and fast. On middle stump, and it is a you-miss-I-hit moment. Misses the flick across the line and Porel must go too. Repairwork needed on the poles
deep square leg is a spectator! Back of a length ball around leg stump. Porel raises his leg while connecting with the swivel-pull, and sends this one into the stands again
tapped down the ground for a single
fullish ball on middle. Anglin into leg. Easy pickings in the powerplay, as Hope clips it off his pads, purposely playing it in the air, and sends it to the deep square leg boundary!
he's ending GT's hopes! Warrier attempts a short ball angling into the batter. But Hope charges down the track before flat-batting an aggressive shot over long on!
over the infield! And that's four more. Full ball on his pads and Hope closes the bat's face while flicking it over the fielder standing at midwicket
tries to respond with a short ball, but Porel was up for that challenge. Swivels swiftly and pulls from a comfortable height, sending another four to deep backward square leg.
smart punch through the packed off-side field! Length ball just outside off. Stays in his crease and crunches a punchy shot off the back foot, sending it between point and cover point
back of a length ball outside off. Porel chases after it, trying to slap it over point, but the height forces him to miss. Wide given
back of a length ball outside off. Rising delivery. Porel tries to cut it over the infield but misses
short of good length ball on middle. He wants to pull but the ball stays a tad low and hits him where it hurts men the most! He's on his knees
back of a length ball on leg stump. Aimed at the batter's elbow, but he manages to get some bat on it, sending a defensive shot to deep backward square
back of a length ball just outside off. Pokes at it, and sends it down to deep third for one
good length ball just outside off. Fended comfortably, tapping it to the off side

welcomed with a beautiful delivery! Length ball outside off but jags in sharply with Hope trying to feel bat on ball with a drive. Cuts him in half, and the ball whizzes between bat and body to the wicketkeeper. Just over off stump.

terrific short ball! And Warrier gets reward for that. Bends his back and gets this to rise onto Shaw. The batter doesn't duck, instead opting to bring the bat in front of his face. It lobs up to short third for an easy catch. He was definitely surprised there

full ball just outside off and he prods forward before playing a solid drive past the bowler. But it doesn't have full power, and Gill runs behind from mid-off to get a fingertip to it. Mohit from mid-on then cleans up
strong wrists! Puts this away over midwicket for four. Good length ball around off. Shaw clips it nicely over the diving fielder, using the wrists to find direction

big lbw appeal! Not out given. Full ball on middle and angling into his pads as he misses the flick. Warrier and Gill have a chat, Saha isn't very convinced, but the captain has taken a review.  Is it sliding down leg? Indeed it is.

smart delivery, and Fraser-McGurk is gone! Fullish ball outside leg, and swinging further down leg. But that's perfect for Johnson because the batter has moved to the leg side, effectively cramping himself. Tries to play a check flick, but plays with hard hands, and the shot has gone straight to midwicket!
good length ball around off. Backs away before attempting an off-side slap. Toe-ends the shot gets manages to squirt it behind Mohit at short third for a boundary
fullish ball outside leg. Moves to the off side to try and ramp it over fine leg but misses. Collects the wide run though
short ball outside leg and climbing onto Jake. He backs away and tries to flat-bat a shot over the off side but he misses his swat. To Saha
short ball around middle and leg. Backs away and flat-bats a tennis-style overhead smash to mid off
scythed over cover! Fullish ball outside off but he makes room to clear his arms, and does so gloriously by slapping it over the off side
full ball outside leg. Swinging away. Tries a big leg-side flick but misses. Collects the wide

good length ball on middle, and sliding down leg. Shaw helps it down to deep fine leg for a couple. Titans take a risk and go for an lbw review after lbw was not given. It came off his pads so given as leg-byes, and the ball is only clipping the outside of leg stump so not out too. But Titans keep their review
full ball sliding into leg stump with the batter missing a flick. Hits his pad and rolls away to the leg side for one
banged past Warrier's left! Slot ball just outside off and he doesn't need a second invite. Drilled to long off for four more!
drives this full ball to the off side but to the fielder
over Warrier's head! Full ball just outside off. Shaping away a bit and Jake keeps a still head before lofting a high-elbow shot to the sightscreen
fullish ball outside off. Shaping away. Pushes a shot towards deep backward point for one
